say: The best engineering teams don't ship faster because they type faster.
They ship on a platform. Years of discipline, that most teams never get to build.
Oh-run turns that discipline into intent. What exists. Where it ships. And the rules it lives by.
One open-source binary compiles it into a single plan. Same inputs, same plan. Every time.
Policy runs at compile time. So when an agent breaks a rule, it fails in the plan. Not in production.
Want the whole platform? Pick a baseline. Connect your cloud.
About an hour later: forty-four components, twelve bounded contexts, three environments. Live, in your repo.
Then every commit converges. Forty-one jobs. All green.
Oh-run. Platform discipline, compiled. Open source.
